section1.title: Welcome to SakuraLands!
content: Playeth with thy Friends from all o'er the Earth.
Joine epic Minigames, Adventure, and much more!

section2.title: Many Tongues!
content: Players from all the world are welcome.
Our Community supporteth sundry languages, so that thou shalt always find Friends to play with.
section2.warning: * Some words be machine translated and mayhap not precise.

section3.title: A Multitude of Minigames!
content: Enjoyeth a wide store of Minigames: Parkour, Skywars, Bedwars, Escape Maze, and more.
There is aye something new to assay!

section4.title: On Safety!
content: We care for fair Play and the Player's Security.
Our friendly Staff Team doth ensure thy experience be safe and full of mirth.

section5.title: Play Now!
section5.content: Joine the Server this very Day.
